description: Byggegrense vassdrag (Elver, bekker og flombekker) Nesodden is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Nesodden kommune. Byggegrense vassdrag (Elver, bekker og flombekker) etter kommuneplanens arealdel 2022-2046 §21. Byggegrense for myr, tjern og dammer er fremstilt i et eget kartlag. Datasettet er en visualisering av byggegrenseavstandene fra kommuneplanens bestemmelser for vassdrag. §21 spesifiserer en byggegrense på 15 meter fra elver, bekker og flombekker. Coverage: Nesodden kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Nesodden kommune. Its keywords include Nesodden kommune, Plan, Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2024-10-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
